mapper.sql: d.id, d.project_id, d.code, d.title, d.severity, d.status, d.repro_steps, d.environment, d.reporter_id, d.assignee_id, d.created_at, r.name AS reporter_name, asg.name AS assignee_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM defect d LEFT JOIN account r ON r.id = d.reporter_id LEFT JOIN account asg ON asg.id = d.assignee_id WHERE d.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY d.code
SELECT FROM defect d LEFT JOIN account r ON r.id = d.reporter_id LEFT JOIN account asg ON asg.id = d.assignee_id WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defect (project_id, code, title, severity, status, repro_steps, environment, reporter_id, assignee_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{code}, #{title}, #{severity}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'open'), #{reproSteps}, #{environment}, #{reporterId}, #{assigneeId})
mapper.update: UPDATE defect SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE defect SET assignee_id = #{assigneeId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_defect_link (test_case_id, defect_id) VALUES (#{testCaseId}, #{defectId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_defect_link WHERE test_case_id = #{testCaseId} AND defect_id = #{defectId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.project_id, t.code, t.title, t.phase, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM test_defect_link l JOIN test_case t ON t.id = l.test_case_id WHERE l.defect_id = #{defectId} ORDER BY t.code
SELECT d.id, d.project_id, d.code, d.title, d.severity, d.status, d.created_at FROM test_defect_link l JOIN defect d ON d.id = l.defect_id WHERE l.test_case_id = #{testCaseId} ORDER BY d.code
